turns.question: Do we sell more at weekends? Between Monday 17 August and Sunday 27 September 2026, what was our average daily revenue on Saturdays and Sundays, and on the other days?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no average-daily-revenue metric (closest: revenue_eur, grouped by day of week), so I can only give the revenue totals it computed for 17 Aug to 27 Sep 2026 (42 days, six of each weekday): Saturdays EUR 2,252.75 and Sundays EUR 2,423.75 (12 weekend days in all), against Mondays 2,340.75, Tuesdays 2,301.25, Wednesdays 2,329.25, Thursdays 2,383.25 and Fridays 2,221.75 (30 other days); each weekday has the same number of days, so the per-weekday totals compare directly and weekends do not stand out as clearly higher. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
